data.title: D · 新婚卧榻的白丝睡袍独白
data.description: 静谧卧室内只有床头一盏泛黄的小台灯亮着。D身穿纯白色的半透真丝晨袍坐在床沿，黑色短斧静静藏在床头柜暗格。她解开晨袍系带，露出雪白精致的锁骨与腰线，双手交叠放在膝头。杀手冰冷的防备在这一刻彻底消融，红眸深情地仰望着你，仿佛在无声诉说着愿将灵魂托付的誓约。
data.location: intimate sunlit bedroom with billowing sheer curtains
data.action: sitting on edge of bed in sheer white silk peignoir robe, collar open revealing delicate collarbones, red eyes gleaming with sincere emotion, tender vulnerable gaze
data.lighting: intimate soft amber bedside lamp casting long gentle shadows
data.mood: total vulnerability, sacred unspoken marriage oath
data.promptProse: Sitting quietly on the edge of a bed in dim bedside light, D wears a sheer white silk robe gently parted at the collar. Her crimson eyes reflect deep, unguarded devotion in the peaceful silence.
data.animaCaption: D sitting on the edge of a bed in a sheer white silk robe, gazing forward with gentle devotion.
